summary.headline: Treya Partners unlocks $1.5M in annual savings for Epika Fleet Services across eight spend categories
summary.narrative: Working under an accelerated timeline ahead of Epika’s sale, Treya Partners completed a strategic sourcing program that captured $1.5 million in annual savings on $18.25 million of addressable spend.  Eight categories are already under finalized contracts, delivering $1.34 million in hard savings, while three additional work-streams are in active negotiation to bring the remaining savings to full realization.  Key wins included a 15 % reduction on Shell lubricants, a unified Comdata fuel-card rebate program, and consolidated filter buying with Fleetguard and Baldwin.  The majority of savings were achieved through incumbent renegotiations, minimizing operational disruption and expediting time-to-value.
